<CLT=cltMIND>We decided to hang out
in the gym.

<CLT=cltMIND>It looks like we're the only ones here...
What should we do?

Physical strength is essential 
for field work.

So first, let us begin with 
basic strength training.
That is a very good suggestion...

Many important documents are 
often discovered during cleaning.

Perhaps I will discover some new 
knowledge while cleaning this room...

That strikes me as a distinct 
lack of proper planning...

Imagine we were doing fieldwork 
on some far-off mountain.

In such a situation, you could 
die if left behind, yes?

<CLT=cltMIND>Korekiyo is completely silent.
That's pretty rare...
